theorem_bridge: Every width<=2 clause is a 2CNF carrier clause.
Every width=3 clause is Horn if it has at most one positive literal, otherwise dual-Horn because it then has at most one negative literal.
The typed carrier conjunction is exactly the original cleaned 3CNF with linear-size identity partition.
A Boolean assignment verifies every carrier in linear time, so unrestricted typed interaction is in NP.
By standard NP-completeness of 3SAT and the identity partition, unrestricted typed interaction is NP-hard.
consequence: A polynomial universal APMA compiler that closes all remaining unrestricted cycle, hyperedge and high-width shared interactions would imply SAT_IN_P and therefore P_EQUALS_NP. The present work does not provide that compiler.
